description:
Snapshot one OCC contract — price, OI, intraday OHLCV, last trade.

    The contract_ticker is an OCC-format symbol like 'O:AAPL260520C00205000'
    (O: + underlying + YYMMDD + C/P + strike-in-thousandths-8-digits).
    The 'O:' prefix is optional.

    Quotes are typically delayed ~15 minutes.

    GREEKS AND IV: the results carry price, OI, OI change, volume, day OHLC
    and last_trade_date; delta/gamma/theta/vega, implied volatility and
    bid/ask are not part of this data. When the user asks for them, call
    this tool, present what it returns, and state plainly that those fields
    are unavailable. Report only values that appear in the results, and
    leave greeks and IV unestimated, including rules of thumb.

    Args:
        contract_ticker: OCC contract symbol.

contract_ticker.description: OCC-format option ticker, e.g. 'O:AAPL260520C00205000'. The 'O:' prefix is optional.
contract_ticker.title: Contract Ticker

name: get_options_contract
